name.doc: What a card calls it; read aloud, so the crop plots are two words in lower case.

promise.doc: The build card's one line: what it does for you, present tense, no full stop. The card holds 42 characters.

description.doc: The long form, on the district card and the upgrade sheet.

glyph.doc: Placeholder while the art is missing.

sprite.doc: Art file stem in src/render/assets. Tiers are its _l<n> files: a level draws the highest one at or below it.

buildable.doc: Off for the Townhall, which the city starts with.

buildTab.doc: The Build menu tab it is listed under.

harvestSources.doc: What its workers go out and harvest in its reach.

providesHarvestSource.doc: The building IS a source of this (the crop plots are Crops).

trains.doc: What it turns out: units, or the Villager.

crew.doc: Who works it, from the character atlas; cast by a stable hash of each worker.

maxLevel.doc: How many levels it has. Level 1 is the build.

goldPerMinutePerLevel.doc: Gold a minute it makes by itself, with nobody living in it, into its store, by level. Empty = it makes none of its own.

storageCapacityPerLevel.doc: What it holds uncollected, in units, by level. Required on anything that makes Gold or harvests; empty on everything else.

fogRevealRadiusPerLevel.doc: The reveal radius by level, the last holding for the levels past it; an upgrade reveals its ring. Empty: fogRevealRadius at every level.

maxCountPerTownhallLevel.doc: How many the city may own at each Townhall level.

requiredPopulationPerLevel.doc: Villagers each level asks for; entry 0 gates level 2.

heroXpBonusPerLevel.doc: Percent more Hero XP the kingdom earns while this stands, the TOTAL at each level. Only the Tavern has any.

armySlotsPerLevel.doc: Armies more the kingdom can have out on the world board while this stands, the TOTAL at each level. Only the War Camp has any.

cost.doc: Currencies, multiplied by the instance ordinal.

goods.doc: Refined goods and precious materials; never multiplied. Precious materials are never asked while the world is shut.

anyPrecious.doc: Precious material of any kind, paid from what the player holds most of (Docs/features/19-world-map.md §7.6). Never asked while the world is shut.

costPerLevel.doc: What each level costs, level 1 being the build.

harmonyCostPerLevel.doc: Harmony demanded: a TOTAL at each level, entry 0 gating the build.

hostsRelic.doc: Holds one city relic, whose effect acts over its aura while an activation lasts (09-relics.md §2.1). A host has one level: how long and how far the relic acts is the relic's own level. It is moved, never built for Gold.
